text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Rhein Kraft!!
Rhein Kraft crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has claimed the final crown of the Triple Tiara!
Blooming into a magnificent autumn flower, it's Rhein Kraft!!

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...A total defeat. As expected... you truly are strong, Ms. Craft."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! Th-Thank you.
But Messiah-san, you're—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. —I was strong, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I can say that. ...I believe I ran a race worthy of saying so."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And so... I will return to Mother
with my head held high and give her the news.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to return
the very words you gave to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward and pure.
A horse girl like the sun... shining down upon
all the flowers blooming in the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—It is I who look up to you,
Rhein Kraft-san.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... together with Rhein Kraft, who returned with a bright, radiant smile,
we celebrated our victory in the Shuka Sho from the bottom of our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~! Next, you make a fist like this and bonk it—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no, no!
Sorry, I got a little too carried away!"
choice_data_list: Just for today, it should be fine...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No no no! ...Though winning the Shuka Sho
makes me insanely happy, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just keep riding this high.
...I want to move on to the next step!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to think properly about what comes next. I want to keep running with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Because everyone gave me their heartfelt support.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...It's so shocking, Trainer.
Can you believe it?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, Cesario,
and Messiah-san too!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: She told me, "You're the one I look up to!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to the senior Tiara Umamusume...
I still... I still haven't accomplished
anything at all, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even so, everyone told me!
All of those wonderful people, to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I want to run more.
I want to keep running more and more!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can become an even more dazzling figure to look up to.
So I can pass it on. So I can leave it behind!"
choice_data_list: I see... Understood. In that case—
I see... Understood. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Line Craft, so full of positive spirit—
I will show her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Triple Tiara route is behind her,
what she should show her juniors next is herself
at her absolute brightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Rhein Kraft's preferred distance.
Carving out a new path as the "fastest of her generation," true to who she is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Next up is the big race to determine the fastest of spring.
choice_data_list: Let's make the Takamatsunomiya Kinen our goal!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In the Senior Year...
In that race where all the speedsters gather!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will carve out my own path forward!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Together!
Start running alongside me, Trainer!
